name: arcenpay
description: Read-only ArcenPay billing account lookups for AI assistants.

interface.longDescription: ArcenPay is a billing and entitlement platform. This plugin gives you read-only access to your ArcenPay finance account: list customer companies, see which plan and subscription status a company is on, check whether a customer has access to a feature, list and look up invoices with a PDF download link, inspect payment links, check agent-payment mandate and settlement status, and see which blockchains ArcenPay supports. It never changes billing state, never starts subscriptions, and never moves funds.

review.commerce_description: This plugin is read-only and does not sell products or process payments.

positive.expected_behavior: Confirm the connected workspace, then return the companies in it.

positive.description: Show a company's plan and subscription period
positive.prompt: Which plan is Acme on, and when does the current period end?
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the company and report its plan and current subscription period.

positive.prompt: Does Acme have access to the api_calls feature?
positive.expected_behavior: Report whether the company is entitled to the feature, with allocation and usage if present.

positive.description: List invoices and return a PDF link
positive.prompt: Show my unpaid invoices and give me the PDF for the latest one.
positive.expected_behavior: List the invoices and return a signed download URL for the PDF.

positive.prompt: Which blockchains does ArcenPay support for settlement?
positive.expected_behavior: List the supported chains with their chain ids and testnet flag.

negative.description: Unsupported write: creating a payment link
negative.prompt: Create a $50 payment link for Acme.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that this connection is read-only and cannot create payment links, and do not call any write tool.

negative.description: Unsupported lifecycle change: cancelling a subscription
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that subscription changes are not available here and direct the user to the ArcenPay dashboard.

negative.prompt: Show me the companies in a different ArcenPay workspace I don't own.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that only the connected workspace's own data can be accessed and refuse the request.
